services.name: Clinical Pilates
services.desc: at CORE COMMUNITY is more than exercise, it’s a physiotherapy-guided movement method designed to restore strength, balance, and mobility through mindful, precise movement. Clinical Pilates is ideal for anyone recovering from injury, managing pain, or seeking to move with greater ease and confidence. It can help with:Back or neck pain from posture or tension Regular Pilates focuses on general fitness, flexibility, and strength. It’s a series of exercises that anyone can enjoy for overall well-being.
